frozen_at_phase: 3→4 boundary (design review, BEFORE any cost/gap/calibration number was computed)
purpose: The spec freezes the cost PARAMETERS but not the ACCOUNTING. 'EUR saved per 10,000 applications' changes with the ledger convention and with how the flat baseline is selected — ambiguities that could be resolved post-hoc to pick the bigger headline. This file closes them before any number exists.

ledger_convention.name: realized-outcome profit ledger
ledger_convention.rejected_anyone: 0   (opportunity cost appears as the profit the policy fails to earn, not as a separate charge)
ledger_convention.savings_definition: profit(policy A) - profit(policy B), scaled to per-10,000-applications
ledger_convention.why_realized_not_expected: policies are DECIDED with p_cal but EVALUATED with observed outcomes (y) - evaluating with p_cal would let a miscalibrated model grade itself

baseline_definitions.best_flat: the single flat threshold maximizing the profit ledger on DEV OOF predictions OF THE DEPLOYED PIPELINE (Phase 5 amendment, made pre-implementation: after the constrained retrain, best-flat is re-selected ONCE on the constrained pipeline's cross-fitted OOF — one fitted parameter, same grid, same ledger — then frozen and evaluated on holdout; never re-optimized on holdout. The unconstrained best-flat 0.095 remains the recorded Phase 4 dev comparison.
baseline_definitions.instance_policy: approve iff p_cal < t*(x) with the frozen Phase 4c parameters

expectation_update_from_design_review: Annuity-implied cash terms are short in this book (median 1.72y, p95 2.9y), so realized cash t* spans ~0.03-0.11 rather than the spec's theoretical 0.02-0.23; revolving (t*=0.175, 9.5% of book) sits above nearly the whole cash range. The instance-vs-best-flat gap expectation therefore leans to the modest end of the spec's 1-3% band. Written before the gap computation; the pre-registered framing ('small but free') stands unchanged.
implementation_pins: IsotonicRegression(out_of_bounds='clip') - holdout scores outside the OOF range must clip, not NaN (observed p_raw range 0.0009-0.8136)
term fallback per config/term_fallback_rule.json before computing t*(x)
cross-fitted calibration metrics use the fold column in oof_lgbm.parquet
revolving uses m_rev=0.18 and ignores term_years entirely
